items.label: Co/Si diffusion couple
items.purity: Co pieces (purity 99.95 wt.%) and Si pieces (purity 99.99 wt.%)
items.quote: Co pieces (purity 99.95 wt.%) and Si pieces (purity 99.99 wt.%) were used and cut into bars with approximate dimension of 5 × 4 × 12 mm3 . After they were carefully grounded and polished, they were bound together with Mo wires to make the Co/Si diffusion couple.
items.synthesis: Co pieces (purity 99.95 wt.%) and Si pieces (purity 99.99 wt.%) were used and cut into bars with approximate dimension of 5 × 4 × 12 mm3 . After they were carefully grounded and polished, they were bound together with Mo wires to make the Co/Si diffusion couple.

items.label: three key alloys
items.quote: In order to determine the homogeneity ranges of αCo2 Si and CoSi compounds at 1373.15 K, three key alloys, which are located in three two-phase regions, viz. |(εCo) + αCo2 Si|, |αCo2 Si + CoSi| and |CoSi + CoSi2 |, were prepared.
items.synthesis: In order to determine the homogeneity ranges of αCo2 Si and CoSi compounds at 1373.15 K, three key alloys, which are located in three two-phase regions, viz. |(εCo) + αCo2 Si|, |αCo2 Si + CoSi| and |CoSi + CoSi2 |, were prepared.

items.quote: The couple was sealed in an evacuated silica capsule under vacuum (1 Pa), annealed at 1323.15 K for 8 days in an L4514type diffusion furnace (Qingdao Instrument & Equipment Co. Ltd., China), and then water-quenched.
The alloy samples were sealed in evacuated silica capsules under vacuum (1 Pa), annealed at 1373.15 K for 3 days in the above mentioned diffusion furnace, and then water-quenched.
